description: This file contains unit tests for the ReferencePlaceholder class, validating its ability to parse and handle placeholder references within JSON strings, including various formats and error cases.

classes.name: ReferencePlaceholderTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the parsing and validation logic of ReferencePlaceholder, including presence checks, entity ID extraction, deep pointer handling, and exception cases.

methods.name: fromCharSequence
methods.description: Tests creation of ReferencePlaceholder from valid character sequences, including standard, with spaces, and deep pointers.

methods.name: fromCharSequenceWithInvalidPlaceholderIsEmpty
methods.description: Verifies that invalid placeholder strings return empty Optionals and null inputs are handled gracefully.

methods.name: fromCharSequenceWithDeepPointer
methods.description: Tests parsing of placeholders with nested deep JSON pointers.

methods.name: fromCharSequenceWithUnsupportedEntityTypeThrowsException
methods.description: Validates that placeholders referencing unsupported entity types trigger the appropriate exception.
